pages.title: Prussian Blue Tablet
pages.text: Iron hexacyanoferrate. Swallowed, it traps radioactive caesium and thallium in the gut so the body passes them instead of keeping them.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Fallout Shelter, Fallout Shelter Stores, Oklo Reactor Ruin chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Coordination Chemistry.
